description: Sitelemetry audits websites across security, technical SEO, AI visibility, analytics and tracking integrations, accessibility, and performance. It returns prioritized findings with evidence, impact, and concrete remediation guidance. Public, non-intrusive checks can assess public websites; protected security modules and full audits require a verified Sitelemetry project. Connections use OAuth with PKCE, and private-network targets are blocked. A Sitelemetry account is required; available audits and usage limits reflect the access already assigned to the connected account.

defaultPrompt: Audit my verified website and prioritize the most urgent fixes.
Check my site for technical SEO and accessibility issues.
Run a full web assurance audit and create a remediation plan.
